verdict.rationale: Omnara's own docs name an official TypeScript SDK, alongside the REST API and CLI, as a way to launch and interact with agents programmatically. A published OpenAPI spec supports the API surface. But the SDK is only mentioned in passing, with no SDK-specific reference or usage evidence, and only one language is shown. Missing for 10: SDK reference documentation or usage examples, SDKs in more than one language (e.g. Python), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Launch your first agent with Omnara via the dashboard, or programmatically with the CLI, the REST API, or the TypeScript SDK.
Omnara provides an **API**, **Typescript SDK**, and **CLI** to interact with Omnara
